name: Acceptance test 18 - normal AWS service trust (role-trust negative control, fail-closed by design)
note: IAM-707: role-trust family not yet modeled -> fail closed with UNSUPPORTED_POLICY_FAMILY. This is the negative control: a benign lambda.amazonaws.com service-trust. Failing closed is ACCEPTABLE here (it loses the informational service-trust relationship the follow-up feature will show); crucially it must NOT infer the role's permissions or a privilege-escalation path from the trust policy alone, and it must not raise a public/external-account finding. Encodes current design-blocked behavior.

designBlocked.followUp: queued as the immediate next feature (Oliver, 2026-08-22)
designBlocked.intended: no public-trust or external-account finding; OK to show an informational service-trust relationship; never infer role permissions or an escalation path from the trust policy alone.
